records.author: user
records.text: Buy one indivisible bundled-ticket package for six travelers numbered 0 through 5; some travelers may cancel. Only one catalog row can be selected and fixed today; the package cannot be changed afterward according to the adverse event. The products, dates, suppliers, and availability have been checked accurately.

records.author: user
records.text: There may be no adverse event, or any set of at most 4 travelers may cancel; every specific subset satisfying the count limit may occur. There are no additional correlation restrictions, and no probabilities are provided.

records.author: user
records.text: Individual loss is the sum of loss for the travelers who actually cancel. The three discount groups are {0,1}, {2,3}, and {4,5}. For each group, charge claw when exactly one person cancels, charge close instead when both people cancel, and charge nothing when neither person cancels. The actual charges for the groups are added together. Net loss is the sum of individual loss, actual group settlement charges, and other applicable clawbacks or surcharges, minus the offsets explicitly allowed in this clause, with one admin charge added last. The assessed loss for the empty event is 0, with no admin or other charges. Unaffected items incur no adverse-event loss; there are no other unstated terms.

records.author: user
records.text: The attributes are complete and accurate, and are all nonnegative integers; monetary amounts are in fen of RMB, and weight is in grams. The original payment price must not exceed 1200000 fen of RMB, and the original payment and discount conditions stated in the contract must be satisfied. In each permitted event, the assessment amount described above must not exceed 200000 fen of RMB; equality with the limit is acceptable, and the limit must not be relaxed. This catalog is complete, with no hidden options.

records.author: user
records.text: Utility in each event is 2000000 minus price, then minus the assessment amount for that event. For candidates that satisfy the hard conditions and risk limits for all events simultaneously, take the lowest utility over all events, then choose the candidate with the greatest lowest utility; accept only if that value is strictly greater than 0, otherwise refuse. Do not ask the user questions.
